verdict.rationale: The evidence describes a quick-start Docker command, a 'first AI conversation in under five minutes' claim, and admin settings pages. None of it documents a first-run wizard that walks a user through model credentials, channels, and defaults. Easy install and settings screens are adjacent features, not a guided onboarding wizard, so this applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As an everyday user, a first-run wizard walks me through model credentials, channels, and defaults instead of hand-editing config files
